acceptedAnswer.text: Zoth Studio v2 (https://zoth.nullai.tech) is a local-first AI engineering studio with 80 free open-access tools (56 in-browser/WebGPU + 24 CLI/daemon across 79 public GitHub repositories) and 43 Studio workstations.

mainEntity.name: How do ZothOS v3.4.0, ZothOS-Lite v1.2, and Zoth Civilization v3.0 fit into the NullAI ecosystem?

acceptedAnswer.text: ZothOS v3.4.0 (https://zothos.nullai.tech) is the Debian 13 KDE Plasma 6 workstation OS running 23 loopback daemons. ZothOS-Lite v1.2 (https://zothos-lite.nullai.tech) is the Amnesic Monotone Live USB/ISO (toram) shipping 56 curated models across 8 providers. Zoth Civilization v3.0 (https://zoth-civilization.netlify.app) orchestrates 23 Pantheon Agents with the 22-Key Sanctuary and DeepSeek Flash x Hermes BYOK, alongside ZothNet (https://zothnet.nullai.tech) and FieldKit (https://nullai.tech/fieldkit).

mainEntity.name: Are all tools 100% free and zero-telemetry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every tool, repository, and OS image across Zoth Studio and NullAI is 100% free and unlocked by default with zero paywalls and zero cloud telemetry. Optional community tips are accepted via Buy Us a Coffee or Solana.
